pins.name: Windy Creek (Cathedral Driveway / Chewuch) Trailhead
pins.evidence: Three in-season round-trip tracks start within 20 m of 48.8722,-120.0033; the Windy Creek Trail page gives this trailhead at the end of FR 39-300, 3.0 mi past the FR 39 junction, and the Cathedral Driveway page states that it is the same trailhead our route text names.

facts.text: In late June the road from Loomis was mostly paved and the last stretch to the trailhead was broken pavement, slow going, with a small fallen tree that drivers had to lift clear.
The long walk through burned forest is exposed to wind; snags creak and sway, and the top 600 ft above the trail is windy and often cloud-covered.
Late June brought only a few short muddy sections and one stretch with three trees across the trail; grade is flat for miles and then mild to the summit.
